watch.summary: A Rocket League streamer laughs while reading a viewer's pushy chat message demanding to play together because no one else is watching.

beats.what: Streamer starts reading a chat comment claiming to be his only viewer.
Streamer denies being lonely, then laughs as he reads the rest of the message.
He quotes the viewer asking 'What are you going to do, just stream to nobody?'
Streamer sarcastically admits 'That is... that's very compelling.'
Streamer cracks up laughing at the desperate logic before moving on.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: What are you going to do, just stream to nobody?
watch.why: The comedy comes from the viewer's brutally honest and manipulative ultimatum, paired with the streamer's amused acknowledgment that the viewer actually makes a good point.
